sentence: This project builds human artificial chromosomes with fully synthetic centromere sequences meant to keep chromosome segregation stable.
This project creates animal and cell line models of salivary gland adenoid cystic carcinoma to identify drug targets and pathways tied to gene fusions.
This project studies the genetic and physiological pathways that let the uterine epithelium regenerate after injury.
This project combines data from several behavioral intervention studies in youth at high risk for HIV, using machine learning to see what works.
This project studies how mitochondria and their structure help triple negative breast cancer cells adapt to and survive chemotherapy.
This project updates genomic analysis tools so researchers can study genetically diverse mice and predict the effects of individual variants.
This project studies proteins, metabolites, microbes and immune features in saliva to find signs that predict who develops Long COVID.
This project manages and analyzes data from mouse and cellular models of rare disease so other researchers can reuse it.
This project tests a treatment that joins an interleukin-2 variant to an antibody, and looks for signs of which kidney cancer patients respond.
This project uses mice with human microglia made from Down syndrome stem cells to study how microglia affect Alzheimer’s disease.
This project develops theory and methods that use ion mobility-mass spectrometry to work out the structure of proteins and other biomolecules.
This project studies how breaking down a certain protein stops the growth of a subtype of lung cancer.
This project studies how voltage-gated sodium channels raise the excitability of sensory neurons and cause pain in Fabry disease.
This project uses mass spectrometry to study the excreted products of DNA demethylation and how they leave the body.
This project builds software and machine learning models that combine brain MRI data from many studies into compact measures of brain structure and function.
This project builds a wearable ultrasonic device that monitors central blood pressure automatically, continuously and noninvasively.
This project tests a vaccine that targets colorectal stem cells to make vaccine antigen and build immune responses against HIV infection.
This project builds an automated software tool that uses deep learning to model how ligands bind receptors for drug design.
This project supports the development of medical devices that diagnose or treat disorders of the nervous system.
This project studies how the menopause transition leads to coronary microvascular disease and works to develop a treatment for it.
